zh.mode.compact.hint: 简洁 · 仅保留步骤摘要
zh.mode.standard.hint: 标准 · 显示关键步骤
zh.mode.detailed.hint: 详细 · 显示完整工具调用
zh.mode.verbose.hint: 完全展开 · 保留全部历史步骤
zh.saving: 正在保存工作步骤展示
zh.saveFailed: 工作步骤展示设置保存失败
zh.pageIntro: 把官方界面缺少的快捷操作集中在这里，并可以按需开关。
zh.switch.steps: 工作步骤展示快捷切换
zh.switch.steps.desc: 在会话标题栏与右侧文件面板的「用资源管理器打开」左侧显示四个步骤档位图标。
zh.switch.chat.desc: 启用后，「已归档会话」会作为独立设置页出现，会话右键菜单也会多出「永久删除」。
zh.switch.automation.desc: 在侧栏新增「自动化增强」面板：支持选中多个任务批量删除、把一条规则绑定到多个会话、投递后自动清理等功能。原版「自动化任务」页保持不变。
zh.switch.detached.desc: 会话右键菜单出现「在独立窗口打开」，也可以把会话行直接拖出窗口；移出的会话在主界面暂时不能进入，侧边栏该行用淡蓝内缩边框标出。关闭后会自动移回全部独立窗口。
zh.switch.recall.desc: 在对话框里用快捷键找回最近发送过的内容：默认 Alt+P 向上重溯（默认最多 100 条），Alt+B 向下回退，退到底部就是空内容。
zh.recall.title: 发送历史重溯
zh.recall.desc: 这里修改重溯按键与最多保留的条数。历史只保存在本机浏览器里，不会写进会话记录。
zh.recall.prev.desc: 在输入框内按下，把上一次发送的内容放回输入框；连续按会继续向前。
zh.recall.next.desc: 向回退到较新的记录；退到最新一条之后再按一次，输入框清空。
zh.recall.max.desc: 1 到 100 条，默认 100 条；超出后最早的记录会被丢弃。
zh.recall.saved: 已记录 {n} 条发送内容
zh.recall.saved.desc: 只记录本机在这个浏览器里成功发送的消息。
zh.recall.needModifier: 请至少按住 Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Meta 中的一个再按字母或数字键。
zh.recall.duplicate: 这个组合键已经用于另一个方向，请换一个。
zh.recall.scope.desc: 开启后每个会话只重溯自己发送过的内容；关闭时所有会话共享最近的一份历史。更改此项会清空已记录的历史。
zh.recall.scopeConfirmDesc: 更改此项将自动清空历史记录（当前共 {n} 条），且无法撤销。是否继续？
zh.pageHint: 归档会话的搜索、取消归档与永久删除位于「设置 → 已归档会话」。
zh.auto.title: 自动化任务增强
zh.auto.intro: 原版「自动化任务」页负责创建、编辑与记录；这里补上它没有的批量删除、多会话绑定和投递后自动清理等功能。
zh.auto.emptyHint: 先在原版「自动化任务」页创建任务。
zh.auto.bindDesc: 为每个选中的会话各复制一份任务（同标题、同指令、同重复规则）；已绑定过的会话会自动跳过。
zh.auto.bindCurrent: 当前目标会话不可重复选择。
zh.auto.deleteDesc: 任务会被删除；已投递的消息和目标会话会保留。
zh.auto.createPrompt: 请根据需求创建一个自动化任务。
zh.auto.noMatches: 没有匹配的自动化任务
zh.auto.name: 自动化任务名称
zh.auto.repeat.cron: 自定义 Cron 表达式
zh.auto.cronHint: 五个字段：分 时 日 月 周；例如 0 9 * * 1-5 表示工作日 09:00。
zh.auto.clean: 投递后清理（仅一次性任务）
zh.auto.ranAdopted: 已投递，任务已绑定新会话
zh.auto.ranInterval: 已投递（可能未记录运行记录）
zh.auto.runIntervalTitle: 仍在投递间隔内：继续投递可能无法记录运行记录
zh.auto.deliveringNote: 该任务正在投递中，请等这次投递结束后再试。
zh.auto.intervalDesc: 该任务仍在宿主的投递间隔内（同一任务两次投递之间需要间隔）。继续投递会绕过间隔立即发出，这次投递可能无法记录运行记录。
zh.auto.conflictTitle: 任务已被其他位置修改
zh.auto.conflictDesc: 这个任务在你打开编辑之后已经发生变化（例如定时投递更新了运行状态，或另一处编辑了它）。取消可以重新打开再看一遍；覆盖保存会用当前编辑框里的内容盖掉那些改动。
zh.auto.bindSkipped: 已跳过 {count} 个已绑定的会话
zh.archivesIntro: 搜索已归档会话的名称、工作区或聊天内容；永久删除只针对已归档且未被宿主加载的本机会话，无法恢复。
zh.searchPlaceholder: 搜索名称、工作区或聊天内容
zh.noArchives: 当前没有已归档的会话
zh.detachedBlocked: 该会话正在独立窗口中显示，先「移回主界面」才能在这里打开。
zh.detachedWindowClose: 移回主界面并关闭窗口
zh.dialogDesc: 只删除已归档且未加载的本机会话记录。删除后 10 秒内还能在提示条里撤销，过期后无法恢复。
zh.deleteUndone: 已撤销删除，会话已恢复。
zh.forceHint: 该会话仍被宿主加载。强制删除会直接移除磁盘上的会话记录；宿主中的该会话随后失效，建议删除后重启 DeepSeek Harness。
zh.retryHint: 如果刚重启过 DeepSeek Harness，可以重试普通删除。
zh.searchMore: 仅显示前 20 条内容匹配，请缩小搜索范围。
zh.transferMoveDesc: 会话会移动到所选工作区，会话标识保持不变，原工作区不再显示它。
zh.transferCopyDesc: 会话的完整对话记录会复制到所选工作区，原会话保持不变。
zh.transferNoTargets: 没有其他工作区可放入该会话。
zh.transferEmpty: 仅显示目录仍然存在的工作区。
zh.transferPickMany: 选择目标工作区（可多选）
zh.transferCopiedMany: 已复制到 {n} 个工作区
zh.transferUndoUnavailable: 源目录不在任何工作区，无法撤销。
zh.transferNoPick: 请至少选择一个工作区

en.saveFailed: Could not save the work-details setting
en.pageIntro: Shortcuts the stock interface does not offer, each with its own switch. Switches are stored in this browser.
en.switch.steps.desc: Shows the four work-details icons left of Open in File Explorer in the session header and the file panel.
en.switch.chat.desc: Adds a separate Archived sessions settings page and a permanent-delete row to the session context menu.
en.switch.automation.desc: Adds an Automation enhancements sidebar panel: delete selected tasks, bind one rule to several conversations, and auto-clean after delivery. The stock Automation tasks page stays as it is.
en.switch.detached.desc: Adds “Open in its own window” to the session menu and lets a session row be dragged out of the window. A detached conversation cannot be opened in the main window and its row carries a light-blue inset frame. Turning this off brings every detached conversation back.
en.switch.recall.desc: Bring back recently sent messages from the composer: Alt+P walks back (up to 100 by default), Alt+B walks forward, and the step below the newest entry is an empty draft.
en.recall.title: Sent-message recall
en.recall.desc: Change the recall keys and how many messages are kept. The history stays in this browser and is never written into a session log.
en.recall.prev.desc: Pressed inside the composer, it puts the previous submission back into the draft; press again to keep walking back.
en.recall.next.desc: Walks forward again; the press after the newest entry clears the composer.
en.recall.max.desc: 1 to 100, 100 by default; older entries are dropped once the stack is full.
en.recall.saved.desc: Only messages this browser actually submitted are recorded.
en.recall.needModifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Meta together with a letter or digit.
en.recall.duplicate: That combination is already used for the other direction.
en.recall.scope.desc: When on, each conversation recalls only what was sent in it; when off, every conversation shares one recent history. Changing this clears the recorded history.
en.recall.scopeConfirmDesc: Changing this clears the recorded history ({n} messages) and cannot be undone. Continue?
en.pageHint: Archive search, unarchive and permanent deletion live in Settings → Archived sessions.
en.auto.title: Automation task enhancements
en.auto.intro: The stock Automation tasks page creates, edits and records tasks. This panel adds what it lacks: bulk deletion, multi-conversation binding, and auto-clean after delivery.
en.auto.emptyHint: Create one on the stock Automation tasks page first.
en.auto.bindDesc: Copies every selected task — same title, instruction and rule — into each conversation; conversations that already have it are skipped.
en.auto.bindCurrent: The current target conversation cannot be selected again.
en.auto.deleteDesc: The tasks are removed; delivered messages and their conversations stay.
en.auto.createPrompt: Please create an automation task based on the requirements.
en.auto.name: Task name
en.auto.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday; e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5 means 09:00 on weekdays.
en.auto.weekdayKeepOne: At least one weekday must stay selected
en.auto.ranAdopted: Delivered — the task now reuses the new conversation
en.auto.ranInterval: Delivered (the run may not be recorded)
en.auto.runIntervalTitle: Still inside the delivery interval; delivering anyway may not record a run
en.auto.deliveringNote: This task is already delivering; try again once that delivery finishes.
en.auto.intervalDesc: This task is still inside the Host's delivery interval. Delivering now bypasses it, and this delivery may not be recorded as a run.
en.auto.conflictDesc: The task changed after this editor was opened (a delivery updated its run state, or another place edited it). Cancel and reopen to review that change, or overwrite it with what is in this form.
en.auto.bindSkipped: Skipped {count} conversations that already had the task
en.auto.pauseNone: Every selected task is already paused
en.auto.resumeNone: Every selected task is already running
en.auto.ruleEx1: Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 09:00
en.archivesIntro: Search archived session names, workspaces, or chat content. Permanent deletion only applies to unloaded archived local sessions and cannot be undone.
en.menuDetachedBack: Bring back to the main window
en.detachedBlocked: This conversation is shown in its own window; bring it back first.
en.detachedWindowClose: Bring back and close the window
en.dialogDesc: Only an unloaded, archived local session can be deleted. For 10 seconds the receipt can undo it; after that it cannot be restored.
en.deleteUndone: Deletion undone; the conversation is back.
en.forceHint: The session is still loaded by the Host. Forcing removes its disk record anyway; the in-memory session becomes invalid, so restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards.
en.retryHint: If you just restarted DeepSeek Harness, retry the normal deletion.
en.searchMore: Showing the first 20 content matches. Narrow your search.
en.footnote: Original Version Enhancements · the chat history part is adapted from dsh-chat-manager (MIT).
en.transferMoveDesc: The conversation moves to the chosen workspace and keeps its session identity; the original workspace no longer lists it.
en.transferCopyDesc: A full copy of the conversation is created in the chosen workspace; the original stays where it is.
en.transferNoTargets: No other workspace can take this session.
en.transferEmpty: Only workspaces whose directory still exists are listed.
en.transferUndoUnavailable: Its source directory is not inside any workspace, so the move cannot be undone.
